entities.name: Ognjen Kuzmić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ognjen Kuzmić is a former Serbian professional basketball player. He has also represented the senior Serbian national team in international competition. Standing at 2.13 m, he played at the center position. He was selected with the 52nd overall pick in the 2012 NBA draft by the Golden State Warriors and won the 2015 NBA Championship with the same team.
